content: Abiyɑmu
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Yeroboɑmun bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑse sɔɔrɑ Abiyɑmu u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ.
U kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑ bɑndu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win mɛron yĩsirɑ Mɑɑkɑ. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Abisɑlɔmun
bii.
Durum ye Abiyɑmun tundo u kuɑ, yerɑ win tii u mɑɑ kuɑ. U ǹ win tii Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃ mɑm mɑm nɡe mɛ win sikɑdo Dɑfidi u kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ Dɑfidin bweseru tɑ n kɑ sɔ̃ɔsire bɑndu sɔɔ nɡe fitilɑ, yen sɔ̃nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn Abiyɑmu kɑ̃ u kuɑ win kɔsire bɑndu sɔɔ, Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Domi Dɑfidi wi, u sĩɑ dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. U ye kpuro mɛm nɔɔwɑ ye u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u ko, mɑ n kun mɔ ye u Uri Hɛti ɡo mɑ u win kurɔ suɑ bɑɑsi.
Abiyɑmun tundo Roboɑmun wɑɑti sɔɔ, tɑbu kun kpɑ wi kɑ Yeroboɑmun bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Ye Abiyɑmu u kuɑn sukum mu yoruɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ win wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, tɑbu wɑ̃ɑ wi kɑ Yeroboɑmun bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Yen biru Abiyɑmu u kpunɑ u ɡu, mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ, Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Mɑ win bii Asɑ u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Asɑ u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Yeroboɑmu Isirelibɑn sunɔn bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yɛndusewɑ Asɑ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ.
U kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru kɑ tiɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Win nikurɔn yĩsirɑ Mɑɑkɑ. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Abusɑlɔmun bii.
Asɑ wi, u sĩɑwɑ dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ nɡe win sikɑdo Dɑfidi.
U kurɔ tɑnɔbu ɡirɑ win tem di. Mɑ u bũu ni win bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ rɑɑ sekɑ kɔsukɑ.
U mɑɑ win nikurɔ yɑrɑ sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔ te u diin di, yèn sɔ̃ kurɔ wi, u Asitɑɑten bwɑ̃ɑroku kuɑ. Mɑ Asɑ u bwɑ̃ɑroku ɡe kɔsukɑ u ɡu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni muku muku. U ɡen torom ɡurɑ u wisi Sedoronin wɔwɑɔ.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ ɡunɡunu mi bɑ rɑ yɑ̃kuru ko mi kɔsuke, bɑɑ mɛ u Yinni Gusunɔ kĩɑ kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kpuro.
U mɑɑ derɑ bɑ kɑ kɛ̃nu nɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, nìn woodɑ win bɑɑbɑ kɑ win tii bɑ yi. Kɛ̃ɛ niyɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ yɑ̃nu ɡɑnu.
Asɑn wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, tɑbu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ wi kɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ Bɑsɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Bɑsɑ u Yudɑbɑ wɔri. Mɑ u Rɑmɑ mwɑ u yen ɡbɑ̃rɑru sɔnwɑ. Kpɑ Yudɑbɑ bu ku rɑɑ mɑɑ kɑ du mi, bu yɑri.

Yerɑ Asɑ u sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ ye yɑ tie kpuro ɡurɑ, sɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɑrumɑni beru yerun di, kɑ sere sinɑ kpɑɑrun ɑrumɑni beru yerun di u kɑ ɡɔrɑ Dɑmɑsiɔ Sirin sinɑ boko Bɛni Hɑdɑdi Tɑbirimɔn biin mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Hɛsionin debubu. Mɑ Asɑ u ɡɔro be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i nɛɛ,

u de su ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke nɛ kɑ wi nɡe mɛ yɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn bɑɑbɑ kɑ win bɑɑbɑn suunu sɔɔ. Wee nɑ nùn sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kɛ̃ɛmɑ. Yen sɔ̃, u de u ɑrukɑwɑni ye kusiɑ, ye u kɑ Bɑsɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ bɔkuɑ, kpɑ u nùn deri.
Bɛni Hɑdɑdi u Asɑn ɡɑri nuɑ, mɑ u win tɑbu sinɑmbu ɡɔrɑ Isirelin wuu mɑrosɔ, bɑ dɑ bɑ Iyoni wɔri kɑ Dɑnu kɑ Abɛli Bɛti Mɑɑkɑ kɑ Kinɛrɔtu kɑ sere mɑɑ Nɛfitɑlin tem kpuro.
Sɑɑ ye Bɑsɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u ye nuɑ, yerɑ u Rɑmɑn ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten sɔmburu deri mɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Tirisɑɔ.

Mɑ sinɑ boko Asɑ u Yudɑbɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ, bɑɑ tɔn turo bɑ ǹ deri. Bɑ dɑ bɑ kpenu kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡurɑ ye Bɑsɑ u rɑɑ kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te sɔmmɔ. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ kɑ ye Gebɑn ɡbɑ̃rɑru sɔnwɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tem sɔɔ, kɑ sere mɑɑ Misipɑɡiru.
Ye Asɑ u kuɑn sukum kɑ sere mɑɑ wuu si u bɑnɑ kpuro kɑ wɔruɡɔɔ te u sɔ̃ɔsi ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ. Win tɔkɔru sɔɔ u nɑɑsu bɑrɑ,
mɑ u kpunɑ u ɡu. Bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ win sikɑdo Dɑfidin wuuɔ. Mɑ win bii Yosɑfɑti u ɡɔnɑ sinɑ.
Nɑdɑbu u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko
Nɑdɑbu Yeroboɑmun bii u bɑndu di Isireliɔ, Asɑ Yudɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yiruse sɔɔ. Nɑdɑbu wi, u kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru bɑndu sɔɔ.
U ǹ sĩɑ dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ nɡe mɛ win tundo u rɑɑ kuɑ ye yɑ Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ.
Mɑ Bɑsɑ Akiyɑn bii Isɑkɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, u nùn seesi u sɛ̃re u ɡo, Gibetoniɔ, Filisitibɑn temɔ, sɑɑ ye Nɑdɑbu kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ wuu ɡe tɑrusi.
Asɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ itɑse sɔɔrɑ Bɑsɑ u Nɑdɑbu wi ɡo. Mɑ u bɑndu di win ɑyerɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di u kpɑ, yerɑ u Yeroboɑmun yɛnuɡibu kpuro ɡo. Bɑɑ ben tɔn turo u ǹ deri nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ Siloɔ sɑɑ win sɔmɔ Akiyɑn nɔɔn di.
Yeni yɑ koorɑwɑ Yeroboɑmun durum sɔ̃ kɑ yèn sɔ̃ u Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinnin mɔru seeyɑ.
Ye Nɑdɑbu u kuɑn sukum mu yoruɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Bɑsɑ kɑ Asɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ, tɑbu wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere be kpuro bɑ kɑ ɡu.
Bɑsɑ u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko
Asɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ itɑsewɑ Bɑsɑ Akiyɑn bii u bɑndu di Tirisɑɔ Isirelibɑ kpuron suunu sɔɔ. U kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nnɛ bɑn te sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ sĩɑ dee dee Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ. Yeroboɑmun yirɑ u swĩi, ye yɑ Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ.

footnotes.text: Abisɑlɔmu - Bɑɑ mɛ yen yorɑ yɑ wunɑnɛ fiiko, kɑ mɛ, ɡɑbɑ tɑmɑɑ Abusɑlɔmuwɑ bɑ kɑ yɑ̃.
